news.title: Sendcloud versterkt positie bij kleinere webshops met overname Sendy
Sendcloud buys Sendy to lock in smaller webshops
Derde deal voor verzendplatform Sendcloud, dat een beursgang heeft beloofd voor 2028

summary: Sendcloud is dutch e-commerce shipping platform, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 7 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 7 about acquisitions.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Eindhoven shipping software scale-up serving 30,000+ online shops; IND sponsor with all jobs here in English and an informal culture.

culture.text: Values are blunt and informal: 'No bullshit', 'Grow & win' and 'Have fun', with an explicit dislike of big egos.
All 8 open roles are in Eindhoven, across sales, finance, software and product.

open.text: SendCloud B.V. and SendCloud Global B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
All 8 jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers; LinkedIn postings drew about 89 applicants on average.

growth.text: Acquired Dutch shipping platform Sendy to strengthen its position with smaller webshops.
The Sendy deal is its third acquisition, and it has promised a stock-market listing for 2028.

worth_knowing.text: Says it serves more than 30,000 online retailers, marketplaces and fulfilment companies across Europe.
